halfLife.notes: Short half-life. IR formulation typically twice daily; XR allows once-daily dosing. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

activeMetabolite.name: N-desalkylquetiapine
activeMetabolite.notes: N-desalkylquetiapine has noradrenaline reuptake inhibition and 5-HT1A partial agonism, contributing to antidepressant-like effects at low doses. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

cypInteractions.switchingRelevance: Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors (clarithromycin, ketoconazole, ritonavir) markedly raise quetiapine levels. CYP3A4 inducers (carbamazepine, phenytoin, rifampicin) reduce levels and may precipitate relapse on co-prescription. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

metabolicRisk.notes: Significant weight gain and metabolic risk, somewhat less than olanzapine. Particularly common on higher doses (≥300 mg). PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

reboundPsychosisRisk.notes: Generally smooth on taper. Rebound insomnia and anxiety can occur due to histaminergic and α1 effects. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

formulationNotes: IR and XR formulations both available. XR cannot be split or crushed. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
